steps.label: fk-base
statements: CREATE TABLE FkParent (Id bigint NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (Id))
CREATE TABLE FkAlterChild (Id bigint NOT NULL, ParentId bigint, Payload text, PRIMARY KEY (Id))
CREATE TABLE FkCascadeChild (Id bigint NOT NULL, ParentId bigint, CONSTRAINT FkCascade FOREIGN KEY (ParentId) REFERENCES FkParent(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY (Id))
CREATE TABLE FkNoActionChild (Id bigint NOT NULL, ParentId bigint, CONSTRAINT FkNoAction FOREIGN KEY (ParentId) REFERENCES FkParent(Id) ON DELETE NO ACTION, PRIMARY KEY (Id))

steps.label: fk-inline-set-null
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE FkInlineChild (Id bigint NOT NULL, ParentId bigint, Payload text, CONSTRAINT FkInline FOREIGN KEY (ParentId) REFERENCES FkParent(Id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY (Id))

steps.label: fk-alter-set-null
steps.sql: ALTER TABLE FkAlterChild ADD CONSTRAINT FkAlter FOREIGN KEY (ParentId) REFERENCES FkParent(Id) ON DELETE SET NULL

steps.label: fk-reject-not-null
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE FkBadnotnull (Id bigint NOT NULL, ParentId bigint NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT FkBad FOREIGN KEY (ParentId) REFERENCES FkParent(Id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY (Id))

steps.label: fk-reject-primary-key
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE FkBadprimarykey (Id bigint NOT NULL, ParentId bigint, CONSTRAINT FkBad FOREIGN KEY (ParentId) REFERENCES FkParent(Id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY (Id,ParentId))

steps.label: fk-generated-control
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE FkGenerated (Id bigint NOT NULL, SourceId bigint, ParentId bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS (SourceId) STORED, PRIMARY KEY (Id))

steps.label: fk-reject-generated
steps.sql: ALTER TABLE FkGenerated ADD CONSTRAINT FkGeneratedReference FOREIGN KEY (ParentId) REFERENCES FkParent(Id) ON DELETE SET NULL

steps.label: fk-metadata
steps.sql: SELECT CONSTRAINT_NAME AS name,DELETE_RULE AS rule FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS WHERE LOWER(CONSTRAINT_NAME) LIKE 'fk%' ORDER BY name

steps.label: fk-before
steps.sql: SELECT 'inline' AS source,Id AS id,ParentId AS parent_id,Payload AS payload FROM FkInlineChild UNION ALL SELECT 'alter',Id,ParentId,Payload FROM FkAlterChild ORDER BY source,id

steps.label: fk-after-dml
steps.sql: SELECT 'inline' AS source,Id AS id,ParentId AS parent_id,Payload AS payload FROM FkInlineChild UNION ALL SELECT 'alter',Id,ParentId,Payload FROM FkAlterChild ORDER BY source,id

steps.label: fk-cascade-control
steps.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM FkCascadeChild

steps.label: fk-after-mutation
steps.sql: SELECT 'inline' AS source,Id AS id,ParentId AS parent_id,Payload AS payload FROM FkInlineChild UNION ALL SELECT 'alter',Id,ParentId,Payload FROM FkAlterChild ORDER BY source,id

steps.label: fk-rollback
steps.sql: DELETE FROM FkParent WHERE Id=5
steps.after: SELECT 'inline' AS source,Id AS id,ParentId AS parent_id,Payload AS payload FROM FkInlineChild UNION ALL SELECT 'alter',Id,ParentId,Payload FROM FkAlterChild ORDER BY source,id

steps.label: fk-after-rollback
steps.sql: SELECT 'inline' AS source,Id AS id,ParentId AS parent_id,Payload AS payload FROM FkInlineChild UNION ALL SELECT 'alter',Id,ParentId,Payload FROM FkAlterChild ORDER BY source,id

steps.label: fk-no-action-parent-present
steps.sql: SELECT Id AS id FROM FkParent WHERE Id=3

steps.label: fk-composite-base
statements: CREATE TABLE FkCompositeParent (Id bigint NOT NULL, K bigint NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (Id,K))

CREATE TABLE FkCompositeChild (Id bigint NOT NULL, ParentId bigint, ParentK bigint, CONSTRAINT FkComposite FOREIGN KEY (ParentId,ParentK) REFERENCES FkCompositeParent(Id,K) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY (Id))

steps.label: fk-composite-delete
statements: DELETE FROM FkCompositeParent WHERE Id=1 AND K=10

steps.label: fk-composite-after
steps.sql: SELECT Id AS id,ParentId AS parent_id,ParentK AS parent_k FROM FkCompositeChild ORDER BY Id

steps.label: storage-catalog
steps.sql: SELECT COLUMN_NAME AS name,SPANNER_TYPE AS type,ORDINAL_POSITION AS ordinal FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE LOWER(TABLE_SCHEMA)='spanner_sys' AND LOWER(TABLE_NAME)='table_sizes_stats_1hour' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION

steps.label: storage-columnar_used_bytes
steps.sql: SELECT s.COLUMNAR_USED_BYTES AS value FROM SPANNER_SYS.TABLE_SIZES_STATS_1HOUR AS s LIMIT 3

steps.label: storage-columnar_used_ssd_bytes
steps.sql: SELECT s.COLUMNAR_USED_SSD_BYTES AS value FROM SPANNER_SYS.TABLE_SIZES_STATS_1HOUR AS s LIMIT 3

steps.label: storage-columnar_used_hdd_bytes
steps.sql: SELECT s.COLUMNAR_USED_HDD_BYTES AS value FROM SPANNER_SYS.TABLE_SIZES_STATS_1HOUR AS s LIMIT 3

steps.label: storage-columnar_coverage_ratio
steps.sql: SELECT s.COLUMNAR_COVERAGE_RATIO AS value FROM SPANNER_SYS.TABLE_SIZES_STATS_1HOUR AS s LIMIT 3

steps.label: storage-columnar_ssd_coverage_ratio
steps.sql: SELECT s.COLUMNAR_SSD_COVERAGE_RATIO AS value FROM SPANNER_SYS.TABLE_SIZES_STATS_1HOUR AS s LIMIT 3

steps.label: storage-columnar_hdd_coverage_ratio
steps.sql: SELECT s.COLUMNAR_HDD_COVERAGE_RATIO AS value FROM SPANNER_SYS.TABLE_SIZES_STATS_1HOUR AS s LIMIT 3

steps.label: storage-combined
steps.sql: SELECT table_name AS name,used_bytes+columnar_used_bytes AS total_used_bytes,columnar_coverage_ratio AS coverage FROM SPANNER_SYS.TABLE_SIZES_STATS_1HOUR LIMIT 3

steps.label: storage-limit-zero
steps.sql: SELECT COLUMNAR_USED_BYTES AS columnar_used_bytes,COLUMNAR_USED_SSD_BYTES AS columnar_used_ssd_bytes,COLUMNAR_USED_HDD_BYTES AS columnar_used_hdd_bytes,COLUMNAR_COVERAGE_RATIO AS columnar_coverage_ratio,COLUMNAR_SSD_COVERAGE_RATIO AS columnar_ssd_coverage_ratio,COLUMNAR_HDD_COVERAGE_RATIO AS columnar_hdd_coverage_ratio FROM SPANNER_SYS.TABLE_SIZES_STATS_1HOUR LIMIT 0

steps.label: jsonb-base
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE JbValues (Id bigint NOT NULL, V jsonb, PRIMARY KEY (Id))

steps.label: jsonb-stored-order
steps.sql: SELECT Id AS id,V AS v FROM JbValues ORDER BY V NULLS FIRST,Id

steps.label: jsonb-stored-group
steps.sql: SELECT MIN(Id) AS first_id,MAX(Id) AS last_id,COUNT(*) AS n FROM JbValues GROUP BY V ORDER BY first_id

steps.label: jsonb-stored-distinct-count
steps.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT V) AS n FROM JbValues

steps.label: jsonb-stored-join
steps.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM JbValues a JOIN JbValues b ON a.V=b.V

steps.label: jsonb-stored-minmax
steps.sql: SELECT MIN(V) AS minimum,MAX(V) AS maximum FROM JbValues
steps.control: MIN/MAX not explicitly promised by comparison/sorting section

steps.sql: SELECT NULL::jsonb IS NULL AS sql_null,'null'::jsonb IS NULL AS json_null

steps.label: jsonb-distinct-subquery-count
steps.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT DISTINCT V FROM JbValues WHERE V IS NOT NULL) AS d

steps.label: jsonb-nonnull-star-count
steps.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM JbValues WHERE V IS NOT NULL

steps.label: jsonb-count-expression
steps.sql: SELECT COUNT(V) AS n FROM JbValues
